scope: Prepared HD Dataset Gate V0: a deterministic, read-only local check that binds one exact dataset/ plus depths/ package to the existing fixed Config-B COLMAP input contract before any reconstruction or HD work. This is ordinary local product and reconstruction engineering. It does not register photos, reconstruct geometry, train a model, enhance content, enable a production worker or establish release authority.

implementation.runtimeSelection: The CLI resolves one interpreter once to an absolute canonical local path before the app starts. Browser requests cannot select an interpreter, package path, tool path or Config-B option.
implementation.runtimeEnvironment: The child receives fixed deterministic Python variables plus the minimum host locations required by the selected interpreter. APPDATA on Windows and HOME on POSIX remain available so an already-installed user-site NumPy dependency can be imported; PYTHONNOUSERSITE is not forced.
implementation.sourceBinding: The intake receipt is re-read before and after validation, every prepared file must match exactly one intake member by path, size and SHA-256, and the fixed parser, CLI, config and source-lock files are checked before and after execution.
implementation.browserDisclosure: The browser DTO and failure copy contain no absolute source, repository, interpreter or temporary paths.

independentCorrectnessReview.finding: The first compiler draft did not prove that preparedFiles was the exact same file set recorded by the intake receipt.
independentCorrectnessReview.resolution: The compiler now requires exact one-to-one equality after sorting by relative path and rejects missing, extra, unrelated, size-mismatched or hash-mismatched prepared files.

fullSuite.qualification: The sole failure is the existing Windows production-release build fixture. It is blocked by an unrelated untracked captured-quality-comparison.d.ts source sibling in the shared dirty worktree, not by a T-540 assertion. Six Node SQLite ExperimentalWarning messages were also emitted.

build.qualification: All diagnostics are the existing cross-package rootDir/file-list boundary problem across nine older core source files. prepared-hd-dataset-readiness.ts is named by zero diagnostic lines.

verification.lineEndingNotices: Git reported only the workspace's existing LF-to-CRLF checkout notices on tracked files.

limitations: Only generated synthetic Config-B data was used for runtime and browser proof; no Grand Hall, Reception, Matterport, XGRIDS or other user/venue package was validated.
Passing this gate establishes the structure and cross-file consistency of one exact prepared package only.
Photo registration, geometric reconstruction, model training, enhancement and HD output generation remain outside this gate.
The result grants no authority to dispatch a worker, upload data, spend money, approve rights, sign or publish.
Real venue quality and physical accuracy remain separate evidence and human-review questions.
